fingerprint.label: wilson_label
fingerprint.question: This is a clinical trial registration, written before the trial started. Predict whether the completed trial will report dosing errors. Dosing errors are medication errors reported as adverse events: overdose, underdose, wrong dose, wrong drug, incorrect route or administration, or dosing schedule errors. Formally, the answer is yes if the lower bound of the 95% Wilson score confidence interval of the dosing-error rate (reported dosing-error events divided by participants at risk, summed over all arms) exceeds 0.01%. About 1 in 20 completed trials meet this criterion.
